ov: A large, migratory predatory fish with a long, flat, pointed bill. Adults lose all their teeth and scales. It is the only member of its family.

why.dg: No unprovoked attacks are known, but a harpooned swordfish can run its sword through a small boat.

rg: Tropical and temperate Atlantic, Pacific and Indian oceans, usually down to 550 m.
fx: It has been recorded as deep as 2,878 m.
notes: The existing fact is confirmed: heater organs next to the eyes warm its eyes and brain 10–15 °C above the water. No why.dg: the source doesn’t cover danger to people.
